name: Connect Four — enforced
description: Drop discs into a 7×6 grid; they fall to the lowest free slot in the column. First to line up four — in any direction — wins. The engine handles gravity, turns and the win.

place.reason: Drop your own colour, on your turn — pick a column that isn't full.

rules.objective: Be first to get four of your discs in a row — horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
howToPlay: Drag a disc over the column you want and drop — gravity drops it to the lowest empty slot.
The column you aim at is what matters; the drop height doesn't.
Full columns and out-of-turn drops are refused; turns advance on their own.
rules.winning: Four in a row wins in any direction. A full board with no four-line is a draw.
